# CLI MENU STANDARD - PCMS

## LAST UPDATE: 2026-07-23

- Loader discovery behavior updated: menu loaders now prefer `config/project-menus` inside each project (PCMS-2026). Loaders fall back to legacy `project-menus` if the new location is absent.
- Menu YAMLs and ACTIONS mapping canonicalized across projects and services. Validation run with `Projects/Tooling/generators/validate_menu_actions.py` — no missing actions reported.
- Compatibility shims added for legacy modules (example: `M3m01r5.cli.menu` exposes `LOG_FILES`, `set_logger`, and `run()` aliases).
- Icons and colour registry pointers normalized to use the workspace canonical colours: `.workspace/.projects_config/GLOBAL_SHARED.d/COLOURS.json`.

See also: Boot sequence architecture in [boot-sequence-architecture](../boot-sequence/boot-sequence-architecture.md).

History
-------
- Canonicalized from `../../../archive/cli-menus/2026-07-23-CLI menu standard-PCMS.md`. See `CHANGELOG.md` and `../../../archive/cli-menus/` for archived snapshots.
